description: Audit planning numbers (Korean auditing standards = ISA): overall materiality from a benchmark × % (ISA 320; typical ranges, not legal rates), performance materiality by risk (low 75%, medium 65%, high 50%), clearly trivial threshold (ISA 450), monetary unit sample size n = population × reliability factor ÷ (tolerable − expected × expansion factor) and sampling interval, and attribute sample size for tests of controls with zero expected deviations (ISA 530). Planning aid only; no audit opinion.

controlPopulation.description: Number of control occurrences (finite population correction)

pct.description: Benchmark % as a fraction (default: typical for the benchmark)

tolerable.description: Tolerable misstatement for MUS (default: performance materiality)

tolerableRate.description: Tolerable deviation rate for attribute sampling (e.g. 0.05)

trivialPct.description: Clearly trivial as a fraction of overall (default 0.05)

title: Plan Korea audit materiality sample
